name: Low-poly PS1 revival
region: Ireland, the United States and online indie scenes
summary: Small indie teams copy the limits of the first 3D consoles on purpose: low polygons, warped low-res textures, vertex jitter, dither and dense fog. The look serves dread and nostalgia, often in empty houses and night streets.

philosophy.core_thesis: An old limit, chosen on purpose, makes a modern world feel like a half-remembered dream.
design_principles: Render at 240–480 px height and scale up with no filter.
Snap vertices to a coarse grid so the geometry jitters.
Use affine texture mapping so textures warp on large faces.
Use textures of 64–128 px with colour-reduced, dithered colour.
Close the view with thick fog at 10–30 m.
Light scenes dimly, with one lamp or a flashlight.

projection_and_camera.framing: Eye height; short views into fog or darkness.

geometry.primitive: A low-poly triangle with snapped vertices.
geometry.budget: 200–1,000 triangles for a character; rooms of simple boxes.
geometry.proportion: Near real scale, slightly off; narrow corridors.

surface.texture_rule: Small photo-sourced textures, colour-reduced and dithered.

palette.strategy: Dark, muddy palettes with one sick accent colour; dither in place of gradients.

lighting.model: Vertex lighting with a few point lights or a flashlight.
lighting.shadows: Few; darkness and fog carry the mood.
lighting.atmosphere: Thick fog, film grain, scan lines or a CRT filter.
lighting.time_of_day: Night, or an empty grey day.

world_and_space.scale: Near real, with tight corridors and low ceilings.
world_and_space.interiors: Empty houses, motels and offices with sparse, wrong-feeling props.
world_and_space.exteriors: Night streets, forests and car parks closed by fog.
world_and_space.threshold: A door opens onto darkness; a cut or a short load.

principles.rule: End every view in fog or darkness within 10–30 m.
Use 1 or 2 layers: a dim ambient and one lamp or a flashlight.
Light one object or doorway as the only bright point.

interface.placement: Minimal; sometimes a retro menu or a CRT frame.
interface.diegesis: Mostly in the world: notes, tapes and signs.

emotion.target_response: Uneasy nostalgia: the viewer feels a familiar old world that is wrong in some way.

avoid_when: The brief needs a clean or sales-grade image.
The tone must be bright and safe.

modifiers.how: Keep the polygons; open the fog and use brighter period colours.
Keep the empty spaces; render with physical light and materials.
